final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt. `npm test` now passes all 18 tests, including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `src/utils/money.js`. `formatMoney` divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set (just JPY for now) that skips the division, and 500 now renders as `¥500`.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals now show yen the same way. That is also correct for them. No other tests use JPY.
